; A callee with more than one block, so the splice has to break the caller's
; block in two rather than paste a straight line in.
define internal i32 @g(i32 %v) {
entry:
  %c = icmp sgt i32 %v, 0
  br i1 %c, label %pos, label %neg

pos:
  br label %done

neg:
  br label %done

done:
  %r = phi i32 [ 1, %pos ], [ 0, %neg ]
  ret i32 %r
}

define i32 @f(i32 %x) {
entry:
  %a = call i32 @g(i32 %x)
  %b = add i32 %a, 100
  ret i32 %b
}
